title: Convert callback APIs to async/await
prompt: src/store.ts and src/settings.ts use Node-style callbacks. Convert them to promise-based async functions: `readJson(file): Promise<unknown>`, `writeJson(file, data): Promise<void>`, `loadSettings(file): Promise<Settings>` and `saveSettings(file, settings): Promise<void>`. Remove the callback parameters entirely and update the tests accordingly. Keep the defaults behaviour of loadSettings (missing file -> defaults).
